patches.summary: Dated room discovery now returns only linked, date-priced Airbnb listings and carries booking URLs through agent-facing outputs.
patches.reason: Agents were recommending unavailable rooms from aggregator/direct-search leads and sometimes omitted the Airbnb URL.
patches.validated_outcome: Formatted with Go 1.26.3; go test ./... passed for library/airbnb. Root audit-public still fails on pre-existing ignored graphify-out artifacts.
